sourceTitle: Food Safety and Standards (Licensing and Registration) Regulations, 2011
authority: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI)

clauses.heading: Licensing and registration of food business
clauses.text: No person shall commence or carry on any food business except under a licence granted by the designated officer under the Food Safety Act.

clauses.heading: FSSAI Statutory SLA Timeline
clauses.text: The Designated Officer shall grant or refuse the licence within 60 days of the receipt of an application complete in all respects.

clauses.heading: FSSAI Registration (small food businesses)
clauses.text: Food businesses with annual turnover up to ₹12 lakh are required to obtain only a Registration Certificate (not a licence) under these regulations.

clauses.heading: FSSAI State Licence
clauses.text: Food businesses with annual turnover above ₹12 lakh and up to ₹20 crore must obtain a State FSSAI Licence from the designated State Licensing Authority.

clauses.heading: FSSAI Central Licence
clauses.text: Food businesses with annual turnover exceeding ₹20 crore, or operating in multiple states, or engaged in import/export, must obtain a Central FSSAI Licence.
